description: This file defines interfaces and classes for inter-process communication (IPC) within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel management, and IPC message types.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class for defining specific IPC message types with parameters and responses.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class managing IPC channels, registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, implementing link management, message handling, and state management.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage.
